Five-star service and delicious dim sum at a reasonable price
May 2026 • Couples
We had another amazing dim sum lunch at Chit Chat. The main waitress named Sandy and her team provided excellent five-star service. Our drinks were always quickly refilled and empty dishes were taken away promptly. We stayed a bit longer than we should have, but they did not make us feel rushed at all. We really appreciated their diligent and cheerful service, it is one of the things that makes Chit Chat such a relaxing place to dine. The restaurant is also very elegant and spotlessly clean.

The dim sum buffet is an excellent deal. I think there were over 50 dishes to choose from, and they are made to order. All of the dumplings and rolls were delicious, especially the ones with abalone, scallops and shrimp. They even provided gloves for one of the prawn dishes so you could peel them without getting your hands dirty. The food wasn't too salty, which is often the case with other Chinese restaurants (which is great if you're watching your blood pressure!). The desserts were also unique and tasty, not overly sweet, especially the mango pudding, the egg tarts and the "carrot cake" (a glutinous rice cake in the shape of a carrot with black bean filling, really yummy). All four of us thoroughly enjoyed our meal. The buffet also includes iced tea (the lychee iced tea is really refreshing) or hot tea. I love that they don't nickel-and-dime you with high drink prices like other high-end dim sum places. We live in the city and have been here several times, and have never been disappointed. We look forward to coming back soon!

The dim sum did not disappoint. Stand-outs were the abalone siu mai, shrimp rolls, taro balls, fried rice, and custard egg tart. Everything was tasty, exept for the seafood soup, which would have been good had it not been so salty.
